"""The single answer to "is this path version-control metadata?" for every write gate."""
from __future__ import annotations

import itertools
import os
from functools import cache
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

GIT_DIR = ".git"


def is_git_metadata(path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> bool:
    """True when any component of *path* is ``.git``, case-folded (macOS/Windows fold case)."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(os.fspath(path).replace("\\", "/")).parts
    return any(part.casefold() == GIT_DIR for part in parts)


@cache
def git_dir_spellings() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Every letter-case spelling of ``.git``, for matchers that cannot fold case."""
    letters = [(c.lower(), c.upper()) for c in GIT_DIR[1:]]
    return tuple("." + "".join(combo) for combo in itertools.product(*letters))
